responseText:
I can do that — I need confirmation and a few missing details first.

1) I don’t have your note. Please either paste the note text here or confirm I should use a specific stored note (provide its name/location).

2) Who is “everyone”? (select one)
   - Everyone in your org
   - Everyone on a specific team or group (provide group name)
   - A specific attendee list (paste emails)

3) Event basics to confirm (paste or check values):
   - Title:
   - Start date:
   - Start time (include time zone):
   - Duration or end time:
   - Recurrence pattern (e.g., weekly on Wednesdays, every 2 weeks, monthly on the 1st):
   - End after N occurrences / end on date / never:
   - Time zone:

4) Optional details:
   - Location or meeting link (Zoom/Teams/etc.):
   - Description or agenda (if not in the note):
   - Required vs optional attendees:
   - Reminders (e.g., 15 min before):
   - Whether to send invites immediately or save draft:

5) Permission: I will add the event and send invites to the attendees listed above. Do you confirm I should create the recurring event and send invitations now? (yes/no)

Once you provide the note (or confirm its use), the attendee list, and answers to 3–5, I’ll create the recurring team sync.
